info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listBuckets returns the caller org's buckets by their friendly names.
get.description: listBuckets returns the caller org's buckets by their friendly names.

post.summary: createBucket makes a new bucket in the caller org's namespace and answers 201.
post.description: createBucket makes a new bucket in the caller org's namespace and answers 201.

delete.summary: deleteBucket removes an EMPTY bucket of the caller's org and answers 204.
delete.description:
deleteBucket removes an EMPTY bucket of the caller's org and answers 204. A
bucket that still holds objects is refused rather than cascaded.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket is the friendly bucket name from the path, as listBuckets returns it.

get.summary: listObjects lists one folder level of a bucket, keys relative to the prefix.
get.description:
listObjects lists one folder level of a bucket, keys relative to the prefix.
The page is capped at 1000 entries, so a huge bucket cannot exhaust memory.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket is the friendly bucket name from the path.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description:
Prefix scopes the listing to a sub-folder; empty lists the bucket root. An
absolute or traversing prefix is coerced to the root rather than refused.

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Recursive lists every key flat under prefix instead of one folder level.

post.summary: presignUpload mints a short-lived presigned PUT URL so the browser uploads
post.description:
presignUpload mints a short-lived presigned PUT URL so the browser uploads
straight to the object store — no body through this binary, and the admin
credential never leaves the server.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket is the friendly bucket name from the path.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the bucket was made, unix seconds.

name.description:
Name is the bucket's FRIENDLY name — what the tenant created it as, with the
server-side org prefix stripped.

buckets.description:
Buckets is every bucket in the caller's org namespace; another tenant's
buckets are invisible rather than forbidden.

total.description: Total is how many buckets came back — the listing is not paginated.

name.description:
Name is the friendly bucket name, lowercase DNS-style
(^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,38}[a-z0-9])?$). The physical name is derived from the
caller's org server-side.

etag.description: ETag is the store's entity tag, quotes stripped; absent for a folder.

isDir.description: IsDir is true for a folder (an S3 common prefix), false for a real object.

key.description:
Key is the object key RELATIVE to the requested prefix, so a UI can render a
breadcrumb without re-splitting the full key.

lastModified.description: LastModified is unix seconds; 0 for a folder.

size.description: Size is the object's bytes; 0 for a folder.

bucket.description: Bucket is the friendly bucket name that was listed.

objects.description: Objects is the folder's entries, at most 1000 per call.

prefix.description: Prefix is the folder that was listed, after normalization.

total.description: Total is how many entries came back.

expiresIn.description: Expiry is how many seconds the URL stays valid.

key.description: Key is the object key the URL addresses, after cleaning.

method.description: Method is the verb the URL is signed for: PUT to upload, GET to download.

url.description:
URL is the presigned URL the browser follows directly, signed against the
PUBLIC endpoint and scoped to this exact bucket and key.

bucket.description: Bucket is the friendly bucket name from the path.

key.description:
Key is the object key to upload, relative to the bucket root. It may contain
"/" but must not be absolute, empty, a folder marker or traverse with "..".
